newsitem.title: CHINA: Expansion helps Tientsin Marine profit.
newsitem.headline: Expansion helps Tientsin Marine profit.

text.p: Tientsin Marine Shipping Co said on Friday that expansion of its major shipping business helped it record a net profit increase of 39.45 percent in 1996.
The company on Thursday posted a net profit of 97.472 million yuan, up from 69.897 million yuan based on domestic accounting standards.
The 1996 net would be 113.459 million yuan based on international accounting stardards, the company's annual report, published on Friday, said.
The firm listed B shares in 1996. The figure for 1995 net based on international accounting standards was not available.

"Last year was a year of both development and competition for the company," the annual report said. "But in the face of intensifying competition, the firm managed to advance due to expansion of its fleet and shipping business."
The company bought two container ships in 1996, acquired the firm Zhuhai North Ocean Shipping Co and bought a 33-percent-stake in Tianshen International Shipping Co.
"These purchases greatly boosted the firm's operational capabilities," the report said.
